sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 31944 of 2023

Applicant :- Suraj Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Shivam Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Shivam Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ravi Kant Kushwaha, learned
Aga for the State.

2.  The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 86 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B, 120B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Modi Nagar,
District Ghaziabad during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his family members including husband of the deceased and according to the FIR marriage of the elder brother of the applicant was performed with the deceased and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for want of dowry and on 09.02.2023 they have burnt her.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is Devar of the deceased and entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless.

He further submits that applicant resides in Hardoi and is in private job and after receiving information of the incident, he arrived at Suraj Singh vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127198830/
1 his home but he was also made accused in the present matter.

sentences.text: He further submits that this fact is even evident from the statement of informant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., in which, he stated that in-laws and husband of the deceased after making contact with applicant ablazed the deceased and this fact clearly suggests that applicant was not residing with them.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 13.02.2023.

5. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that it is a case of burn injury and applicant is Devar of the deceased and his Bhabhi died within seven years of marriage under abnormal circumstances but he could not dispute the fact that there is no allegation against him and even from the statement of the informant recorded during investigation it reflects that applicant was residing outside.
6.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. Applicant is Devar and although his Bhabhi died due to burn injury in her matrimonial home within seven years of her marriage and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant in paragraph-13 specifically averred that he is in private job and resided in Hardoi and on the date of incident he was not in his home and averment made by the applicant in paragraph-13 to the affidavit also finds support from the statement of informant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and from its perusal it appears that applicant was not residing along with the deceased and other family members including her husband and in-laws in the same house.
8.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant - Suraj Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
